description: Run Omarchy on MacOS without any setup.

latest_release.name: v1.4.0
latest_release.body:
This release puts Omarchy on every Mac display, brings back the boot splash, and keeps the VM working after Omarchy's latest updates 💻

You can upgrade by replacing the app with the new `TryOmarchy.dmg`. Your VM and its files are kept, and Omarchy inside the VM keeps updating with `omarchy update`.

# Features

* Omarchy on every Mac display: turn on **All Displays** under Immersive Mode, and each display becomes its own Omarchy display, arranged as in System Settings by @xavierforge, @themartiano in #407
* Each display keeps the scale you pick in Omarchy's monitor panel, and the pointer stays under the Mac's cursor on every display by @themartiano in #457, #458
* The Omarchy boot splash shows again while the VM starts by @volodymyrkatkalov in #430

# Fixes

* After `omarchy update`, the VM boots the new kernel instead of hanging on the old one by @themartiano in #440
* The desktop keeps drawing after Omarchy updates to Hyprland 0.57 by @themartiano in #442
* In full screen with the camera notch, the pointer stays on target after a Space switch or a display move by @themartiano in #443
* Shift, Ctrl and Option stay held when the mouse moves, with an external keyboard and mouse by @marcusmt in #421
* Try Omarchy starts after its app is renamed, and says why when it can't start by @themartiano in #441
* The audio bridge no longer keeps PipeWire busy while the desktop is idle by @sscarduzio in #424

## Dev

* Document how to remove the old VM after importing it by @stevederico in #431
* Make the desktop check in CI and e2e more reliable by @themartiano in #444, #450, #451, #452, #453

---

Full changelog: [v1.3.0...v1.4.0](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0)

Just download `TryOmarchy.dmg`, the rest of the installation will be handled automatically 👇

detail.readme:
Try Omarchy

Omarchy inside Apple's Ecosystem.

Try Omarchy is a Mac app that runs stock Omarchy in a fast virtual machine deeply integrated with macOS. Use it as your daily driver, or give Omarchy a try and migrate to a native install. Integrations include Apple's universal clipboard, AirPods, Touch ID, the Retina display, Super shortcuts, Mac clipboard, audio, camera, battery, and a shared folder. The official Omarchy Mac image is used, so it behaves and updates like any other Omarchy install. ## Get started 1. Download the latest `.dmg` from [Releases](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy/releases). 2. Drag **Try Omarchy** to **Applications** and open it. 3. Optionally configure permissions for the full experience. 3. Click **Launch Omarchy**. The first launch downloads the Omarchy image (about 3 GB). You need an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 15 or newer and about 15 GB of free space. ## How it works - **Omarchy is stock.** The VM runs the official `aarch64` Omarchy from Omarchy's own repositories. Try Omarchy adds one package, `try-omarchy`, and changes no file that Omarchy owns. - **Omarchy updates itself.** Run `omarchy update`, or use **Update → Omarchy**, whenever you like. Each update takes a snapshot first, so you can roll back from the boot menu. - **The app updates the Mac integrations.** Each app release brings a newer, local `try-omarchy` package, which the VM installs at its next boot. - **Edge channel for now.** Omarchy publishes for ARM on `edge` only. ## What you get - Native CPU speed through Apple's Hypervisor framework, and GPU-accelerated graphics - A full-screen or windowed desktop that follows your display's resolution, scaling and supports the notch - Command works as Super. Mac keyboard layouts are mapped correctly - Two-way clipboard for text and images - Mac audio output and microphone, with live device switching - The Mac camera, available to Omarchy as a webcam - The Mac's battery in the Omarchy bar, including detailed information - One shared Mac folder, under the same name (`~/Work` stays `~/Work`) - Touch ID for `sudo` and 1Password - Port forwarding, SSH, bridged networking and USB passthrough (experimental) **Limitations:** - Video decoding uses the CPU, so multiple high-resolution playback can stutter. - Vulkan is not available. - Nested virtualization is opt-in for now. ## Manual Settings live in the launcher. Once Omarchy is running, open them with **Setup → Try Omarchy Settings**. The [manual](manual/README.md) covers what's specific to running Omarchy in Try Omarchy: - [Getting started](manual/getting-started.md) - [Omarchy on a Mac](manual/omarchy-on-a-mac.md) - [Files, network and devices](manual/files-network-devices.md) - [Touch ID](manual/touch-id.md) - [Updates and your data](manual/updates-and-data.md) - [Troubleshooting](manual/troubleshooting.md) For Omarchy itself, see [the Omarchy manual](https://learn.omacom.io/2/the-omarchy-manual). ## Help - **Problems with Try Omarchy:** see [troubleshooting](manual/troubleshooting.md), or open an [issue](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy/issues). - **Problems in Omarchy itself:** if it also happens on real hardware, report it to [Omarchy](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy). - **Security issues:** follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## Power users and contributors - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): how the app, QEMU, the image and the guest package fit together. - [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): principles, building from source, tests and CI. - [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents. - [docs/](docs/README.md): how each part works. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). Created by [Eduardo Martinez](https://x.com/martiano). Omarchy and bundled components keep their own licenses; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). The Omarchy mark comes from the [official brand kit](https://omarchy.org/brand/) and remains subject to Omarchy's trademark rights.
